title: Persistence of closed-fibre flatness along the tower
statement: For a Noetherian local model tower, closed-fibre flatness at an index persists at every later index.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre), first two paragraphs; Closed-fibre flatness on a tail of a Noetherian local model tower

proof.text: For i ≤ j put I = m_i S_i, K = I S_j, and J = m_j S_j. The commuting rs square identifies K with the extension to S_j of the image of m_i in R_j. IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le applied to rmap gives K ≤ J, using Ideal.map_map and Ideal.map_mono. This is the three-line ideal calculation in the Lean proof.

Install the transition algebras on S_j and T_j. The st square supplies the scalar tower S_i → T_i → T_j. Apply Module.flat_quotient_localized_baseChange with base S_i, top T_i, new base S_j, new top T_j, ideal I, and module N_i. The localization witness is fibreTransition. Thus (S_j/K) tensor_{S_j} (T_j tensor_{T_i} N_i) is flat over S_j/K.

The inclusion K ≤ J constructs the quotient algebra S_j/K → S_j/J. Base change the preceding flat module to S_j/J, then cancel the intervening quotient tensor factor using TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange. This proves flatness of (S_j/J) tensor_{S_j} (T_j tensor_{T_i} N_i).

Take the equivalence e from moduleTransition, restrict it from T_j to S_j, and tensor it with the identity of S_j/J. TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.congr gives an S_j/J-linear equivalence to (S_j/J) tensor_{S_j} N_j. Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv transports flatness, which is exactly the required later closed-fibre statement.

proof_origin.place: Algebra, proof of Tag 00R7, second paragraph; quotient transition comparison realized by the proved localized-base-change-quotient theorem, followed by base change to the later maximal ideal and the specified module transition. Written by J4.

theorem NoetherianLocalModelTower.fiberFlat_of_le
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {S' : Type w} {M : Type t}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra S S'] [Module S' M] [Module S M]
    [IsScalarTower S S' M]
    (X : NoetherianLocalModelTower R S S' M) :
    letI := X.preorder
    letI := X.commR
    letI := X.commS
    letI := X.localR
    letI := X.algRS
    letI := X.addN
    letI := X.moduleS
    ∀ (i j : X.ι), i ≤ j →
      Module.Flat
        (X.S₀ i ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ i) (X.S₀ i))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ i)))
        ((X.S₀ i ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ i) (X.S₀ i))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ i))) ⊗[X.S₀ i] X.N₀ i) →
      Module.Flat
        (X.S₀ j ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ j) (X.S₀ j))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ j)))
        ((X.S₀ j ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ j) (X.S₀ j))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ j))) ⊗[X.S₀ j] X.N₀ j)
